description: This file defines the WPEFramework::PluginHost::Config class responsible for managing configuration options for the Thunder-712 project. It includes nested classes for handling JSON configuration, environment variables, plugin settings, processing options, and paths. It also provides methods for accessing configuration data, updating binders, and substituting variables in strings.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Represents the main configuration for the Thunder-712 project, managing paths, network settings, security, plugin configurations, environment variables, and more. Provides methods for accessing and updating configuration data, handling variable substitution, and internal path management.

classes.name: Config::JSONConfig
classes.description: Nested class handling JSON-based configuration data including environment variables, process settings, paths, and optional Hibernate configuration.

classes.name: Config::JSONConfig::Environment
classes.description: Represents key-value pairs for environment variables with override option.

classes.name: Config::JSONConfig::ProcessSet
classes.description: Specifies process-related configuration parameters such as user, group, priority, and policy.

classes.name: Config::InputConfig
classes.description: Encapsulates input handling configuration, including locator, type, and output enablement.

classes.name: Config::Observables
classes.description: Holds paths for proxy stub and plugin configuration.

classes.name: Config::ProcessContainerConfig
classes.description: Optional container configuration, enabled when PROCESSCONTAINERS_ENABLED is defined.

classes.name: Config::HibernateConfig
classes.description: Optional Hibernate configuration, enabled when HIBERNATE_SUPPORT_ENABLED is defined.

classes.name: Config::InputInfo
classes.description: Provides read-only access to input configuration details such as locator, type, and enablement status.

classes.name: Config::ProcessInfo
classes.description: Provides read-only details about the process configuration such as user, group, priority, and policy.

methods.name: Config::Substituter::Substituter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the variable map with predefined substitution rules.

methods.name: Config::Substituter::Substitute
methods.description: Performs variable substitution within a string input, replacing placeholders delimited by '%' with actual values.

methods.name: Config::JSONConfig::Environment::Environment
methods.description: Constructor initializing environment key-value pair objects.

methods.name: Config::InputConfig::InputConfig
methods.description: Constructor initializing input configuration with default locator and type.

methods.name: Config::Config
methods.description: Main constructor loading configuration from file, parsing JSON, and setting internal state accordingly.

methods.name: Config::SetPrefix
methods.description: Sets a new prefix and updates the web prefix accordingly.

methods.name: Config::MessagingCategoriesFile
methods.description: Indicates if messaging categories are stored in a separate file.

methods.name: Config::ProcessContainersLogging
methods.description: Returns the process container logging level (if enabled).

methods.name: Config::HibernateLocator
methods.description: Returns the Hibernate locator string (if enabled).

methods.name: Config::Accessor
methods.description: Returns the network node ID used for server access.

methods.name: Config::Communicator
methods.description: Returns the NodeId for the communication endpoint.

methods.name: Config::Binder
methods.description: Returns the NodeId used as the binder address.

methods.name: Config::ObservableProxyStubPath
methods.description: Returns the observable proxy stub path.

methods.name: Config::PostMortemAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a reason is allowed for post-mortem dump.

methods.name: Config::Background
methods.description: Indicates if the server runs in background mode.

methods.name: Config::Substitute
methods.description: Performs variable substitution on input string with plugin context.

methods.name: Config::SetIdleTime
methods.description: Sets a new idle timeout value.

methods.name: Config::SoftKillCheckWaitTime
methods.description: Returns soft kill check wait time.

methods.name: Config::HardKillCheckWaitTime
methods.description: Returns hard kill check wait time.

methods.name: Config::EthernetCard
methods.description: Returns the configured Ethernet card string.

methods.name: Config::DelegatedReleases
methods.description: Returns whether delegated releases are enabled.

methods.name: Config::Plugins
methods.description: Returns an iterator over plugin configurations.

methods.name: Config::Add
methods.description: Adds a plugin configuration if not already present.

methods.name: Config::UpdateAccessor
methods.description: Updates the network NodeId accessor based on current configuration.

methods.name: Config::UpdateBinder
methods.description: Updates the binder NodeId based on current configuration.

methods.name: const Plugin::Config * Plugin(const string & name) const

ctags.pattern: /^            Config(Core::File& file, const bool background, Core::OptionalType<Core::JSON::Error/
